english.note: Use this as the broad, all-purpose adjective for something beyond the laws of nature, including divine or paranormal forces.

examples.english: Believers think miracles are manifestations of supernatural power.
examples.traditional: 信徒相信神蹟係超自然力量嘅顯現。
